args.sql:
SELECT 
    h.housenum AS home_id,
    ta.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count' AS car_count
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
JOIN transportation_assets ta ON h.housenum = ta.housetag
WHERE i.wateraccess LIKE 'Yes%'
  AND (i.roadsurface ILIKE '%Asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%Concrete%')
ORDER BY CAST(ta.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count' AS integer) DESC
LIMIT 1;
